channel.title: Algeria - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Algeria, every source cited.

item.title: Algeria identifies 362 sites for tourism investment
item.description: Minister Houria Messaoudi announced the availability of land parcels across 26 provinces to boost the hospitality sector.

item.title: Algeria seizes 2.4 million psychotropic pills
item.description: 10 suspects arrested and charged with drug trafficking in Algiers

item.title: Algeria launches major non-hydrocarbon export drive
item.description: The operation on November 7 will see companies like Condor and Faderco ship goods to multiple countries.

item.title: Algerian businesses explore trade opportunities in China
item.description: Linyi city hosts international buyers conference to foster economic and investment cooperation.

item.title: Algerian police recover 23 billion centimes from criminal network
item.description: Authorities arrested 25 individuals involved in counterfeiting, fraud, and money laundering across multiple regions.
